हि ind. (Never used at the
beginning of a sentence) It
has the following senses:--
1 For,
because (expressing a strict or
logical reason); अग्निरिहास्ति धूमो हि
दृश्यते G. M.;

.
--2 Indeed,
surely; देव प्रयोगप्रधानं हि नाट्यशास्त्रं

; न हि कमलिनीं दृष्ठ्वा ग्राहमवेक्षते
मतंगजः

.
--3 For instance, as is
well known; प्रजानामेव भूत्यर्थं स ताभ्यो
बलिमग्रहीत् । सहस्रगुणमुत्स्रष्टुमादत्ते हि रसं
रविः

.
--4 Only, alone (to
emphasize an idea); मूढो हि
मदनेनायास्यते

.
--5 Sometimes it is
used merely as an expletive.

हि {c5c} P. (हिनोति, हित; caus.
हाययति; desid. जिघीषति)
1 To send
forth, impel.
--2 To cast, throw,
discharge, shoot; गदा शक्रजिता जिघ्ये

.
--3 To excite, incite,
urge.
--4 To promote, further.
--5
To gratify, please, exhilarate.
--6
To go or proceed.

ही ind. An interjection of
1
Surprise (ah!); हतीवीधलसितानां ही
विचित्रो विपाकः Śi. 11. 64; or ही
चित्रं लक्ष्मणेनोचे

; (often
repeated in theatrical language in
this sense).
--2 Fatigue,
despondency or sorrow.
--3 Reason
(cf. हि).
